Definition: Rejecting a claim because you cannot imagine how it could be true. Our imagination is not the measure of reality.
Example: Someone argues, 'I can't see how evolution could produce an eye, so it couldn't.'
FaithDiscussionExample: Someone argues, 'I can't understand the Trinity, so it can't be true.'
HowToRespond: Return to evidence: "Our imagination isn't the measure — let's look at the evidence."
